brief: Three-step mobile onboarding carousel with illustration area, headline, body copy, pagination dots, and CTA. Knobs: step count, active step, accent color, dot style, and skip-link toggle. Price: 9

flaws: The faded side phones push body copy and the 'Skip'/'Back' links to very low contrast. In the default and light-brand renders the secondary-screen text is barely legible. It reads as a depth effect, but a designer pasting the asset into a deck gets greyed-out copy they cannot use.
Preset Iris is pixel-identical to the defaults, so it wastes a preset slot and shows no range.
At maximum step count the layout drops from three phones to two, offset as a pair. The active step is shown at full size, but steps 1–3 disappear entirely, so the 'carousel' framing weakens.
The illustrations are fixed per step, and no knob swaps or tints them independently of the accent. In the dark probe the purple secondary in the illustrations is hard-coded, not brand-derived.
grades.lesson: When you de-emphasise secondary elements (inactive screens, background cards), use scale, position, blur or a uniform overlay rather than fading text colour. Keep any text that remains visible at legible contrast in every brand theme. Also check that each preset differs visibly from the defaults before shipping it.
